# Example Role Mandate

This is the mandate for `example-role`, installed by the package template.
Replace it with the actual mandate text for the role(s) your package ships.

A mandate states, in plain language, what the role is accountable for, what it
may decide on its own, and when it must escalate. Keep it short and concrete —
it is read by the human operating the role, not just the kernel.

## Accountable for

- (describe the role's core responsibility)

## May decide independently

- (describe the decisions this role makes without escalation)

## Must escalate

- (describe what forces a hand-off to the escalation target)
